name: Petershagen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Petershagen (crossed white keys above a bridge on red).
history: Municipal flag of Petershagen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Petershagen arms — crossed keys above a bridge on red
